source.evidence: ScoreBase/PDMX score 149074 is 3/4, SATB, 89 measures, 14 parts with basset horns, bassoons, three trombones, strings and organ. Independent Hostias sources give 89 measures, with the Quam olim reprise beginning at measure 55. The ScoreBase key metadata C minor falls within the movement's modulating E-flat-major/C-minor tonal field.
